failed_conditions.quote: The `sequence` node in the V3 behavior tree library works differently than in V2. There seems to be no way to have two subtrees running simultaneously in V3 unless you use the `parallel` node.

resolution.quote: This is an alternate implementation of #1336 that the team mostly prefers.

notes: All four dimensions verified against primary sources. E2: the V2/V3 SequenceNode semantic change is confirmed verbatim — BehaviorTree.CPP 2.5.2 sequence_node.h: "If any child returns RUNNING, previous children will be ticked again." vs 3.0.9: "If any child returns RUNNING, previous children will NOT be ticked again." (both read via raw.githubusercontent.com). The failed-condition quote matches PR #1336 body exactly, and the implicated element api:BT::SequenceNode is the boundary element whose tick semantics changed; element_retyped (declaration changed, element still present) fits. Loudness silent_documented/run is correct: the only ERROR in the reporter's log is the downstream controller progress-checker message, not a BT-library diagnostic; the reporter found the defect by instrumentation ("I put print statements inside PlannerServer::computePathToPose(). It was not ticking at 1Hz."). Resolution recommended is correct: PR #1371 merged (merge commit 4ece520b, "fixes #1301, fixes #1307") but no source shows the reporter's obstacle scenario working against the fix.
